ai_summary: 20 Microns Limited reported Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit after tax of Rs. 1,774.40 Lakh, a 5.22% year-on-year increase, despite a marginal 1% decline in total revenue. A notable red flag is the inclusion of management-certified, unaudited financial results from three subsidiaries and two associates within the consolidated figures, raising concerns about comprehensive external oversight and the completeness of the auditor's review.
